question: Which trek in Bhutan is considered to be the crown jewel of Bhutanese trekking?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Snowman Trek**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Snowman Trek **is widely **considered to be the crown jewel of Bhutanese trekking**
 
• The Snowman Trek is **one of the most difficult** and longest treks in the world, typically taking around 25 days to complete.
 
• The trek typically** starts in the Paro or Punakha regions of western Bhutan.**
 
• Major passes include the Rinchenzoe La, Gangla Karchung La, and Jaze La, among others.
 
• The trek usually **concludes in the region of Bumthang in central Bhutan.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Dagala Thousand Lakes Trek **

 
 
• The Dagala Thousand Lakes Trek is a **captivating and relatively lesser-known trekking route in Bhutan.**
 
• The **trek takes place in the Thimphu region of Bhutan** and leads into the Dagala mountain range, known for its numerous alpine lakes.
 
• **One of the highest points on the trek is ****Labatama Pass** (4,520 meters) 
 
 
• ​ It offers majestic views of the Bhutanese Himalayas, including peaks like Mount Kanchenjunga and Mount Jomolhari.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Laya Gasa Trek**
 
 
• The Laya Gasa Trek is a **remarkable and challenging trekking **route in Bhutan.
 
• The trek starts in the district of Paro and passes through the Gasa district, which is in the northern part of Bhutan near the Tibetan border.
 
• The Laya Gasa Trek **typically takes around 14 to 17 days to complete.**
 
• It is **considered a strenuous **trek due to its length, high altitude, and rugged terrain.
